changeSet.author: ticketwave
changeSet.comment: Bookings: optimistic-lock version column. Without it, two concurrent requests against the same booking (e.g. two refund initiations racing each other) can both read CONFIRMED before either commits its status change, producing duplicate refunds. JPA bumps/checks this on every update; a stale write now fails fast with a 409 instead of silently overwriting the other request's change.
